Container.Name: seerr-mcp
Container.Overview: MCP server for Overseerr and Jellyseerr, exposing all 170 API operations to Claude.ai custom connectors and Claude Code. Sign-in is handled by a built-in OAuth 2.1 front. Put a reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel in front of port 8551 and set ISSUER to that public https URL.
Container.Requires: Requires a running Overseerr or Jellyseerr instance and its API key.

Config.Name: Seerr URL
Config.Description: URL of your Overseerr or Jellyseerr instance, reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Seerr API key
Config.Description: From Overseerr/Jellyseerr: Settings, General, API Key.

Config.Name: Public URL (ISSUER)
Config.Description: The public https URL this server is reached at, for example https://seerr-mcp.example.com. Required.

Config.Name: Sign-in password
Config.Description: Set on first start only, stored as a hash in /config. Leave empty after the first run.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port the front door listens on. Point your reverse proxy or tunnel here.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: OAuth database, password hash and optional static token.
